To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the neutrino mass spectra can be determined from two-zero textures.
the neutrinoless beta decay can be fully determined from two-zero textures, and that the neutrino mass is a function of the neutrino masses.

(1) the two-zero textures are the most predictive ones among all possible neutrino mass matrices; (2) the neutrino mass spectra can be fully determined from two-zero textures and, consequently, definite predictions can also be made for the neutrino mass sum, the effective mass in neutrinoless double-beta decay and the neutrino mass ordering.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of neutrino oscillations in the context of two-zero texture of the neutrino mixing matrix, and the determination of the neutrinos mass spectrum and the neutrinoless beta decay.
the study of the neutrino oscillations, the neutrino mass and mixing, the neutrinoless beta decay, the neutrino magnetic moment, the solar neutrino problem and the atmospheric neutrino problem.
the neutrino mass matrices, and the neutrinoless beta decay.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Majorana phases of neutrino mass matrix, which are not observable in neutrino oscillations, can be fixed by two-zero textures of neutrino mass matrices.
we can predict the absolute neutrino mass scale from two-zero textures.
we have found a new way to determine the neutrino mixing matrix and the neutrino mass hierarchy from the neutrino mass matrices.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the two-zero texture of the neutrino mixing matrix, which is a generalization of the well-studied tri-bimaximal mixing pattern, leads to the normal mass hierarchy with a mass difference between the heaviest and the second heaviest mass eigenstates of the order of the mass squared of the lightest neutrino.
, in general, the neutrino mass ordering can be determined from the neutrinoless beta decay, provided that the Majorana phases are not too close to 0 or π.
the neutrino mass hierarchy is determined by the neutrino mass ordering.
